```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden believes all companies, including technology companies, should be held accountable for the harm they cause.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has raised the alarm that social media and other platforms have allowed abusive and criminal conduct like cyberstalking, child sexual exploitation, and non-consensual intimate images to proliferate on their sites.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden has called on Democrats and Republicans to unite on legislation to address issues related to abusive and criminal conduct on social media and other platforms.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Surgeon General issued an advisory warning that he cannot conclude social media is safe for children and adolescents.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will pass bipartisan legislation to protect kids' privacy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will pass bipartisan legislation to stop Big Tech from collecting personal data on kids and teenagers online.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will pass bipartisan legislation to ban targeted advertising to children.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will pass bipartisan legislation to put stricter limits on the personal data technology companies collect on all people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has strengthened legal protections for survivors and victims of non-consensual intimate imagery, including those generated by AI.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has strengthened legal protections for survivors and victims of non-consensual intimate imagery, building on the federal civil cause of action established under the Violence Against Women Act Reauthorization of 2022.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
